sources.title: Nonvanishing of generalised Kato classes and Iwasawa main conjectures
claims: For positive even analytic rank and p>3 of good ordinary reduction, generalized Kato classes kappa_p(E) are constructed in the relevant p-adic cohomology/Selmer setting under the paper's auxiliary hypotheses.

The source explicitly calls construction of non-torsion rational points or Selmer classes for analytic order at least two a central open problem and notes the diagonal-cycle classes may be zero a priori.
Under h1-h3 and Choice 5.2.1, if L(E,s) has positive even order, kappa_p(E) nonzero implies dim_Qp Sel(Q,V_pE)=2.
Conversely, assuming Selmer dimension two, kappa_p(E) is nonzero if and only if loc_p is nonzero.
When nonzero in that setting, kappa_p(E) spans the strict Selmer group ker(loc_p).
In the Corollary 5.1.3 setting kappa_p(E) itself lands in ker(loc_p), so loc_p nonzero must be witnessed by an ambient Selmer direction other than kappa_p(E).
The expected equivalence between kappa nonvanishing and analytic order two is presented conjecturally via equivariant BSD, not as the theorem proved in this paper.
scope_hypotheses: Choice 5.2.1 local splitting/inertness/ordinarity and two auxiliary L-value nonvanishing conditions

sources.title: On the non-vanishing of generalized Kato classes for elliptic curves of rank 2
claims: Provides first rank-two cases and a leading-term anticyclotomic p-adic L-function formula in terms of derived p-adic heights and an enhanced p-adic regulator.
This is a scoped/special result, not a general theorem that complex analytic rank two forces generalized-Kato nonvanishing for arbitrary E/Q.

sources.authors: Francesc Castella; Chi-Yun Hsu; Debanjana Kundu; Yu-Shen Lee; Zheng Liu
sources.title: Derived p-adic heights and the leading coefficient of the Bertolini--Darmon--Prasanna p-adic L-function
claims: For an algebraic analogue, the leading-coefficient part of a p-adic BSD conjecture is proved under source hypotheses.
The order-of-vanishing part is said to follow from the expected maximal non-degeneracy of an anticyclotomic p-adic height.
Therefore this source does not supply an unconditional complex-rank-two-to-p-adic-regulator-nondegeneracy bridge.

sources.title: On refined nonvanishing conjectures by Kurihara and Kolyvagin
claims: Current 2026 work refines Kurihara/Kolyvagin nonvanishing and determinant-of-Selmer-complex methods.
It is a different special-element/discrete-Selmer representation and is not source-composed here as the missing generalized-Kato analytic-rank-two bridge.

derived_scope_result.statement: Within Castella arXiv:2312.01481's exact theorem cell, generalized-Kato nonvanishing is equivalent to the conjunction of Selmer dimension two and nonzero localization: forward nonvanishing forces dimension two, and under dimension two Theorem 5.2.3 gives nonvanishing iff loc_p is nonzero. Moreover the nonzero generalized Kato class spans ker(loc_p), so the localization witness is transverse to the class itself.
derived_scope_result.route_consequence: The R6 good-ordinary successor representation does not bypass the previously isolated BSD-A1a2 localization/positive-rank residual. It makes that residual sharper: analytic rank two must supply an ambient Selmer dimension-two plus transverse-localization statement before the theorem yields kappa nonvanishing.
not_claimed: No impossibility theorem for generalized Kato methods.
No inference that analytic rank two implies Selmer dimension two or loc_p nonzero.
No promotion from p-adic/one-prime information to arbitrary-rank BSD or the complex leading-term formula.
No new Sha, regulator, Tamagawa, torsion, or extra/trivial-zero theorem.

falsifiers_checked: Reverse the proved implication kappa!=0 -> Selmer dimension two: rejected.
Use loc_p(kappa)!=0 as the witness: rejected because the source places kappa in ker(loc_p).
Treat a derived p-adic height formula as automatic nondegeneracy: rejected; current source states maximal non-degeneracy as expected in the relevant order-of-vanishing step.
Treat 2026 Kurihara/Kolyvagin refined nonvanishing as the same analytic carrier: rejected by representation/source mismatch.
